where: first paragraph: "ou bien φ est partout ramifié, ce qui implique dim X ≤ r-2 , k étant de caractéristique nulle"
scan: dim X ≤ r-2, with no check over the X (the checks over X̌ elsewhere on this page are clearly visible)
note: The dual variety is meant. In characteristic 0, if φ : P(N) → X̌ is everywhere ramified, then dim X̌ < dim P(N) = r-1; criterion (3.2.4) (codim of F ⊂ X̌ in P̌^r is ≥ 2) is then trivially satisfied, as the sentence says. This matches Corollaire 3.5.0 b) dim X̌ ≤ r-2. The bound cannot apply to X itself: for a hyperplane X ⊂ P^r, φ is everywhere ramified (X̌ is a point) but dim X = r-1. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
